Done. `out/T4/solution.py` ran successfully on the first execution and wrote `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors, 64 merged.

The script:
1. Loads all three checkpoints, asserts identical key sets, then asserts every one of the 180 non-MLP tensors is bit-identical (`torch.equal`) across base/ft1/ft2, plus shape/dtype agreement on all 244.
2. Merges each of the 64 MLP tensors in float32 with both task vectors taken against the **unmodified** `base` dict (nothing is written back into it), then casts to float16.
3. Copies every other tensor from the base (cloned, so no shared storage on save), and fails loudly unless exactly 64 were merged and the dict — and the reread file — has exactly 244 tensors.

`out/T4/REPORT.md` is written per the template.
